answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 25851 Country: Canada Title: If the man is in Pakistan sitting with two gawahs , and a maulam, The girl is in Canada. She has no Gawah. But she listens to the whole Khutba and agree and qabools the Nikkah. Is this Nikkah Sharayi ? Question: If the man is in Pakistan sitting with two gawahs , and a maulam, The girl is in Canada. She has no Gawah. But she listens to the whole Khutba and agree and qabools the Nikkah. Is this Nikkah Sharayi ? Answer ID: 25851 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2086/H=623/th=1431) It is not enough to listen to full sermon and the words of ijab-o-qubool (proper exchange of the words for nikah) rather it is necessary for both the parties to be present in the meeting of nikah, which is missing in the questioned mentioned above. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
